_readme: Eighth read for the Cerritos Ironworker ladder (S331, SkyForge): the high school list by other routes (Sam, sheet 36 card 2). Read 7 (run 37247286802) closed three: cerritos.ctecourseconnect.com, where web search places Cerritos's public agreement search, has no DNS record and no archive capture; Cerritos is not among CATEMA's 30 California sites; Cerritos's How To Receive Articulation Credit page names no list. Its 2016 capture of Statewide Career Pathways' showagreements.php lists agreements by career path (careerpathid 3 Building Trades and Construction, 11 Manufacturing and Product Development) through a GET form. This read takes the archive's index of those query addresses and the two career paths' captures; Cerritos's CCAP page with its collapsed Participating High Schools section opened (the reader's new expand step); and Cerritos's board agenda on BoardDocs, where web search finds the CCAP agreement with Downey Unified (Downey, Warren and Columbus high schools).

outside_hosts.boarddocs.com: BoardDocs, where Cerritos College's Board of Trustees publishes its agendas and their attachments, including the CCAP partnership agreements with its high school districts
outside_hosts.archive.org: the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine, which keeps captures of the Statewide Career Pathways database from when it was live

questions.hs_articulation: Cerritos's list of articulated high school courses, and which route Columbus High's welding pathway uses.
